messages:
deploy-bot: Started canary rollout for release v2.14.3 -> canary=5% (eu-west). Changes: prefix-cache TTL reduced; kernel selector update.

sre_victor: @deploy-bot saw a p95 jump in prefix-cache region ~30s after shift :eyes:

deploy-bot: Alert: SLO p95 latency 451ms -> 780ms, 5xx rate 0.12% -> 0.95% (spike). Metrics: https://metrics.redwood/alerts/1768456780

eng_releases_kate: Paging @sre_victor @platform_raj — is this within expected canary variance or should we pause?

sre_victor: I'm seeing correlated 5xx with kvcache miss storms on eu-west. Not normal. Suggest pause canary and pin to previous stable variant.

platform_raj: If we pause, recommend pin traffic back to v2.14.2 and keep a small slice for observability. Command ready: `/deploy rollback --to-tag v2.14.2 --scope canary`

eng_releases_kate: Executing rollback now: `/deploy rollback --to-tag v2.14.2 --scope canary` (me)

deploy-bot: Rollback started (triggered by eng_releases_kate). Target: revert canary routing to v2.14.2 across eu-west. ETA ~2m.

sre_victor: Also rolling kvcache config back: bucket-size -> 128MB and restarting worker pool in eu-west-1 as a precaution.

pm_olivia: Noted customer-facing latency impact. Holding change window and updating release notes: "v2.14.3 rolled back from canary due to kvcache-induced latency spike."

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Canary traffic now on v2.14.2. Quick metrics: p95 ~460ms, 5xx ~0.14% — trending back to baseline :white_check_mark:

eng_releases_kate: Opening follow-up ticket for root cause analysis and scheduling an internal patch: #INC-3421 (kvcache GC tuning + kernel selector behavior). Assigning to @eng_ml_team.

sre_victor: Quick postmortem notes: collect debug traces for the canary window and compare kernel selection logs. Example logs captured:

```text
kvcache: evict_rate=12000/s at 1768456831
kernel_selector: chosen=optv2 seq_len=512 fallback=quant3
worker-123: oom_retries=0 restart=1
```

platform_raj: I'll add a temporary routing rule to avoid the optv2 kernel path for canary traffic until we validate the selector change.

pm_olivia: Thanks team. I'll update the external release notes and notify stakeholder list. We'll reschedule the change window after the patch and a narrow canary validation.

sre_victor: :thumbsup:
